decisions.reason: As an extension of the firm’s established psychiatric and therapeutic services and already given its own page, management is likely to justify the investment and keep it unless clear failure emerges.

The carpentry workshop builds on existing practical therapy and production capabilities and has visible website commitment, so escalation of commitment favors continuation despite it being somewhat less central than core care services.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm’s core support offer, and even with only modest public presentation the strategic fit makes management likely to persist with it.

Because senior-living counseling is close to the core eldercare business and was highlighted on the home page, management is especially likely to keep it to maintain consistency with its public direction.

The retail shop is less central and only lightly presented online, but it still builds on sheltered-workshop activities and prior investment, so management would more likely continue than withdraw it.
